# note: rare Twilight Regalia (3.29), copied by Cameron with Ctrl+Alt+C, verbatim. Searing Exarch (Exquisite) and Eater of Worlds (Grand) implicits; a Heist armour enchant "8% increased Explicit Defence Modifier magnitudes" (RePoE ArmourEnchantmentHeistDefenceEffect1) kept as an enchant, whose "— 8% Increased" note on the three defence prefix headers is display-only (same shape as the Simplex Amulet fixture); "Priest's" hybrid ES + mana shown as Tier 2, which only the per-type ladder gives (T4 on the shared BaseLocalDefencesAndLife ladder); "of the Order" is an unveiled mod that prints a tier (VERIFY 15); a Master Crafted hybrid attribute suffix without a Rank; the fractured suffix "of the Underground" is the Delve (fossil-only) mod DelveDexterityGemLevel1, in no class file, resolved from other_mods as kind "other" with the "no v1 action can roll it" warning; "Fractured Item" footer.
